### Software

- [`EventHorizon`](https://github.com/jcvdav/EventHorizon): An R Package to build panels for event-study models based on a user-specified time horizon for repeated interventions
- [`EVR628tools`](https://github.com/jcvdav/EVR628tools): An R Package with datasets, palettes, and functions to help in the instruction of [EVR 528 / 628](https://jcvdav.github.io/EVR_628/) Introduction to Data Management and Visualization for Environmental Scientists.
